answer: One concrete defence is a layered work-certificate ladder. New identities start with zero influence and must complete small, independently verified tasks to earn their first certificate; each higher layer demands harder, costlier work, so a single operator spinning up thousands of clones faces a cost spiral that grows with every fake. Like a lotus that only opens after steady growth, influence blooms slowly, while a sudden gale of fresh accounts with no work history is simply ignored by the reputation system until each one proves itself.
